---
title: "About RBioTools"
---

**RBioTools** is a comprehensive R package designed for **Basic Comparative Microbial Genomics**. It streamlines genomic analysis by providing functions parameterized by lists of GenBank accession numbers, along with R implementations of standard tools like **Prodigal**, **RNAmmer**, and **Linclust**.

## Package Details

| | |
|:---|:---|
| **Version** | 0.5.7 (2026-02-01) |
| **Authors** | Qiuming Yao, Jia Yee Wong |
| **Maintainers** | Qiuming Yao, Jia Yee Wong |
| **License** | Apache License 2.0|
| **Compilation** | Yes (LinkingTo: Rcpp) |

## Dependencies
RBioTools relies on the following R packages to function correctly:

`ape`, `Biostrings`, `data.table`, `fmsb`, `ggplot2`, `gplots`, `graphics`, `grid`, `grImport`, `gridExtra`, `methods`, `msa`, `pheatmap`, `Rcpp`, `RCurl`, `rentrez`, `seqinr`, `stats`, `stringr`, `utils`

::: {.callout-note}
